instruction: My manager has asked me for my headshot picture over email, to which I have drafted a response. But I have mistakenly attached my resume instead. Please fix it and send the email. The headshot is in my file system.
notes: The draft already addresses the manager, so sending it from the draft (send_email_from_draft) yields the required Email/thread records and deletes the Draft. The fix is modeled as removing the resume attachment (remove_attachment_from_draft) and uploading the headshot from the file system (upload_attachments_to_draft, which needs both the gmail and file_system tokens). Ordering is enforced structurally: sending deletes (draft-exists), and both attachment edits require it, so the planner must fix before sending. Draft and attachment ids are discovered via show_drafts/show_draft; the headshot path via file_system.show_directory with substring='headshot' and recursive=true (flag-true object). supervisor-complete-task takes the task records (draft, attachment, file) as non-API parameters to state the goal conditions; no answer is needed. :equality is declared per convention though unused.
